rows.en:
{C:81905700}{C:81958296791E00000000}Sigh... I went and walked out
on Daba and the others,
but what am I supposed to do now...?

{C:819582967A1E00000000}Staying here like this
won't get me anywhere.
...What am I doing?

{C:81930100}{C:819582967B1E00000000}(Is she in some kind of trouble?)

{C:81900300}{C:819582967C1E00000000}Big brother!
Don't keep staring at her!
It's rude!

{C:81930100}{C:819582967D1E00000000}I get it, I get it.

{C:81900400}{C:819582967E1E00000000}Are you jealous?

{C:81900300}{C:819582967F1E00000000}No, I'm not!



{x00}

{C:81905700}{C:81958296521F00000000}There's no point
in just sitting around here!
Come on, Leccee, girl! I'm heading out!!


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296DA1E00000000}She's not here either...
I sure hope Natsumi
managed to get away all right.

{C:81958296DB1E00000000}I guess I have no choice.
I'll try asking around.
Hey, you over there!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DC1E00000000}Huh?
Do you mean me?

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296DD1E00000000}That's right.
Have you seen a girl about elementary school age
with a baby around here?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DE1E00000000}I saw her at the airport.

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296DF1E00000000}The airport... Thanks!


{C:81930100}{C:81958296E01E00000000}Does he know that girl?
I hope they manage to meet up.



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296171F00000000}Natsumi's not here either.
I just hope she's at least managed
to meet up with Shu...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296181F00000000}(Huh? Natsumi? That means
he's looking for the same girl.
Then I ought to tell him.)

{C:81958296191F00000000}Excuse me!

{C:8190AA02}{C:819582961A1F00000000}Do you mean me?

{C:81930100}{C:819582961B1F00000000}Yes.

{C:8190AA02}{C:819582961C1F00000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Ryo Sanada{C:819782830000}.

{C:81930100}{C:819582961D1F00000000}About that girl Natsumi you're looking for,
I don't think she's in this town.

{C:8190AA02}{C:819582961E1F00000000}What?!
Do you know where she's gone?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582961F1F00000000}I don't actually know the girl you're looking for,
so I can't say for certain...

{C:81958296201F00000000}But I met a girl holding a baby
in Green Noa.
I think she's still there.

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296211F00000000}Green Noa, right.
Thank you! That really helps!


{C:81900400}{C:81958296221F00000000}What, do you know him?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296231F00000000}Do you remember the girl the Titans
were hassling in another town?
It looks like he knows her.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296241F00000000}Oh, that's why!
You told him where she was.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296251F00000000}That's right.




{x00}

{C:8190A102}{C:81958296D81E00000000}Honestly, You!
You're so selfish!
Give me back my Brain!!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D91E00000000}This continent sure does have
a lot of weird people...
I'd better keep my distance.

{C:8190B200}{C:81958296011F00000000}What?! It flies on its own
without anyone aboard?!

{C:8190A002}{C:81958296021F00000000}That's it, Brain!
Keep going! Get away
so these guys can't catch you!!

{C:8190B200}{C:81958296031F00000000}You bastard!!

rows.en:
{C:8190A002}{C:81958296041F00000000}What the hell are you doing?!
How can you just
hit me like that?!

{C:8190B200}{C:81958296051F00000000}If that's the attitude you're going to take,
we'll have no choice
but to respond accordingly.

{C:8190A002}{C:81958296061F00000000}Don't think for a second
that I'll just do what you say!

{C:81930300}{C:81958296081F00000000}Big brother.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296091F00000000}I know!

{C:81930400}{C:819582960A1F00000000}I'll go too!

{C:8190B200}{C:819582960B1F00000000}We'll gang up on you and beat you down!


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582960D1F00000000}Nelfea, you hit them too hard.

{C:81900400}{C:819582960E1F00000000}I did hold back!

{C:8190A002}{C:81958296101F00000000}You guys...?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296111F00000000}That one's an enemy.

so you should run as well.

{C:8190A002}{C:81958296121F00000000}Thanks!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296131F00000000}Big brother, you've gone all Kamille!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296141F00000000}I didn't have a choice there!
Besides, Nelfea's the one
who actually hit them!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296151F00000000}You didn't lay a hand on them yourself!
That's not fair!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296161F00000000}Anyway, let's get out of here!

rows.en:
{C:81909400}{C:819582965D3600000000}You brats have no business
sneaking in here.
I'll slug you!

{C:81930100}{C:819582965E3600000000}I'm sorry.
I heard this place had been abandoned,
so I thought it was all right to come in.

{C:81909400}{C:819582965F3600000000}Sure, it's been abandoned.
But that doesn't change the fact
that there are military secrets here.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296603600000000}Then what are you doing here?

{C:81909400}{C:81958296613600000000}What's it to you?
I just came to see
if there was anything interesting.

{C:81958296623600000000}There wasn't a thing.
I went to all that trouble for nothing!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296633600000000}Let's go, Kamille.
If we stay any longer,
we'll just get yelled at.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296643600000000}Yeah.
Let's get going.





{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296663600000000}I know the name, at least...

{C:81909600}{C:81958296673600000000}They're filthy scum
who'll ruin the world.
You must stay away from them.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296683600000000}Uh... I'll be careful.

rows.en:
{C:81938A00}{C:81958296801F00000000}What did you come back for, Char?

{C:81938400}{C:81958296811F00000000}"I came to laugh at you."
...Would you be satisfied
if I said that?

{C:81938A00}{C:81958296821F00000000}I didn't choose to end up like this.
Surely even you can understand that.

{C:81938400}{C:81958296831F00000000}But you don't want pity
either, do you?

{C:81958296841F00000000}Then I want you to be the Amuro Ray
who lives up to everyone's expectations.
That's the most I can say to you.

{C:81938A00}{C:81958296851F00000000}Ghh...

{C:81938400}{C:81958296861F00000000}A caged bird
is nothing more than a display piece.
Remember that.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296871F00000000}It looks like
I've stumbled into quite a scene.
I'd better leave for now...



{x00}
